proposal.before: Sheyiyu counterattacked at the Hun River and was beaten again.
proposal.after: Sheyiyu led cavalry in pursuit and fought at the Hun River, and was defeated again.
proposal.sourceChinese: 涉奕于率騎追戰于渾水，又敗之。
proposal.reason: 率騎 explicitly states that Sheyiyu led cavalry, and 追戰 describes pursuit and combat. Counterattacked obscures the pursuit and drops the cavalry. Preserve the named subject, river and repeated defeat; the paired literal already conveys these propositions and needs no change.
